title: Prove a sharp 112-call bound for active coded-mode repair
body:
The center-free producer has eight code modes, but these do not provide an eight-call Gaussian repair. This package proves **sharp 112-call bounds** for the actual one-sided correction and eight-mode extraction/expansion, even with chronological linear feedback, saved responses, fanout, free mode rebasing and cross-block mixing. Homogeneous direct sums require 112m calls. The conjugated adapter J and J-I also need at least 112 calls; their exact optimum remains open.

The consequence is concrete: a standalone uncoding patch costs at least 112 paid calls while the removed eight H8 calls save at most 64 moment units. That route loses at least 48 units per FULL. This extends #4932's one-parallel-bank scope to active chronological calls; it does not extend that predecessor's per-channel grade-two conclusion.

The model uses same-width fresh fields and a fixed finite projective monomial group, with the same one-column map lifted across every digit column. The lower bounds hold at sufficiently large widths. Already-paid native observations, nonuniform per-column address operations, compressed sandwiches and full-controller admission remain outside scope. **No improved κ or global caller impossibility is claimed.**

Validation on publication commit `0e8a13c251a9be1029114cda8b4194f05f3a23ec`:

- CPython 3.12.15 registered normal/optimized replay and separate binary checker pass.
- Exact source checks cover all 12,544 port pairs, 5,824 supported code terms, mode-factor/Gram identities and four rejection controls.
- Committed-byte/source-history preflight passes for all 17 package/input files.
- Official committed export integrity check and both optimized direct checkers pass without Git.
- Separate AI-agent proof reviews are included; no independent human or formal-kernel acceptance is claimed.

Publication branch starts from refreshed canonical main `20a1e31bc6009b9b3f4d084bbaadc6350e34fcba`; frozen scientific sources remain pinned to `4c0a359d88f22f05189d51f48387750b801a45d4`. Latest common-code moving-stage and coherent fresh-D work was reviewed and its distinct scope retained. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4930#discussioncomment-19141406.

Credit Dugongue/#4929, Dillon/#4933, Chris R/Clear1nsight/#4932, the passive saved-query clarification, Cinna Davis, Cao Yifan, zxv, and the retained native/compiler and rank-cut lineage. Prepared for Dillon with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Selected frontier and predecessor files are unchanged.
